text:
mira: Heads-up — brought up atlas-11b-int3 on staging. Quick failures: formatting collapse for nested lists and ~5% hallucination uptick on long docs. I uploaded 58 suspect prompts to s3://redwood-staging/atlas/fails/4312345670/list.json. Looping in @jon @peter for dedupe + quant triage.

jon: grabbing now. First pass shows lots of HTML-escaped inputs and some code-block heavy prompts. Which tokenizer was used at ingest?

peter: ran a short quant-smoke on int3 artifact. Observed repeating patterns after ~2100 tokens and occasional fabricated IDs. Snippet: ```
quant-smoke: model=atlas-11b-int3
longform_fail_rate=0.047
issues=repetition+fabricated_ids when seq>2100
gpu_warn=matmul-fallback on some nodes
```

label-bot: Fail list + manifest uploaded: s3://redwood-staging/atlas/manifest_4312345670.csv (fields: prompt_id, md5, tokenhash_v3, embed512_hex). ACL: eng-ml-read.

mira: ingest used tokenizer v3. Proposed temporary golden: "atlas-longform-regress-4312" target 240 (120 hallucination/recall, 120 format/truncation). Dedupe rules: exact tokenhash_v3 => drop; embed512 cosine >= 0.92 => cluster & keep exemplar; for paraphrase clusters at 0.88 surface top exemplar. @jon can you run dedupe and report counts?

jon: Starting dedupe. Preprocess: html-unescape -> strip control-chars -> normalize whitespace -> compute tokenhash_v3. Running dedupe with thresholds you listed.

peter: Routing mitigation: add rule to route estimated_output_tokens>2000 to atlas-q4b-compat until runtime kernel fix. I'll add a canary 10% for 6h.

label-bot: Dedupe complete: 17 exact tokenhash_v3 drops, 11 near-dup merges. From 58 fails -> 30 uniques. Augmented candidate pool with 210 harvested long-docs stratified by source => final candidate pool 240. Candidates written to s3://redwood-staging/atlas/golden_candidates_4312345670.csv.

mira: Great. Label ops needs a clear rubric and examples. I'll draft rubric: HALLUCINATION, FABRICATED_ID, TRUNCATION, FORMAT_COLLAPSE, PARTIAL_OK. Example cases saved: s3://redwood-staging/atlas/rubric_4312345670.md.

ash: Label ops capacity: 240 items -> ~36-48h with 2 annotators + 1 QA. Can start tomorrow morning if rubric+manifest are final by EOD. Need cluster metadata and a note on tokenhash version in manifest.

jon: I added cluster_id, cluster_size, tokenhash_version=3, and a note about HTML normalization to the manifest. Also flagged 6 items with cross-tokenizer collisions for manual review.

peter: canary-bot: routing rule applied: atlas-longform-temp -> atlas-q4b-compat (10% traffic) until 2026-03-28T10:00:00Z. Ticket INF-9205 opened for kernel fallback behavior.

mira: I'll kick off an eval-harness run after first 40 labeled items. If hallucination/repetition exceed baseline + 1 sigma we'll pause the canary and revert routing.

label-bot: Labeling manifest and candidates available: s3://redwood-staging/atlas/golden_candidates_4312345670.csv and s3://redwood-staging/atlas/manifest_4312345670.csv.

ash: Scheduling annotators: start 2026-03-26T16:00:00Z PST, 2 annotators + 1 QA. ETA first 40 labels ~13h. I'll post board links.

jon: small note — tokenizer v3 had a known behavior with ZERO WIDTH joiners in code blocks; I added tokenhash_note=ZWJ_NORMALIZED to manifest.

mira: thanks everyone. I'll collect the first eval and post summary here. :thumbsup:
